FreshRetailNet-50K
	


	
		
	
	
		Dataset Overview
	

FreshRetailNet-50K is the first large-scale benchmark for censored demand estimation in the fresh retail domain, incorporating approximately 20% organically occurring stockout data. It comprises 50,000 store-product 90-day time series of detailed hourly sales data from 898 stores in 18 major cities, encompassing 865 perishable SKUs with meticulous stockout event annotations.
